sources.note: Korean release 2024-09-11, 171 cards / 52 kinds, including 8 basic energy kinds. Does not by itself validate each artwork.
SVK 001/044 찬란한 리자몽 name and Korean numbering; artwork visual inspection not completed.
52 canonical entries, original Korean master references retained.
52 types: numbered 001-044 and eight basic-energy types; 013/014 swapped relative to master/Collectory. Not authoritative for per-card mapping.
All 52 Korean card kinds visually checked using official Korean watermarked art URLs individually recorded on each card.

evidenceConflicts.resolution: Official Korean watermarked artwork directly confirms 013/044 곤충채집세트 and 014/044 네스트볼. Master unchanged.
Official Korean 032/044 card art confirms subtitle 투로박사. Retain canonical master name 박사의 연구; no master mutation.

limitations: 52 Korean card kinds checked; all 52 official Korean watermarked images visually verified and all 12 themes adjudicated. The eight basic energy kinds are physically unnumbered. Image binaries were not self-hosted or deployed.

cards.artworkDescription: 산악 눈 풍경을 배경으로 푸른 하늘을 날며 불꽃을 뿜는 찬란한 리자몽
